_help.purpose: Raster start of the die-imaging sequences (TakeImageLEC, TakeImageLECDie, TakeImageBAM, TakeImageSEG, TakeImageL0_*, TakeImageL1_*, TakeImageL2): offset in um from the die position reached by MoveChuckRowColumn to the centre of the first tile. Used by GenerateRasterSteps when start_x_um / start_y_um are left empty.
_help.LEC: ER2 and ER2B share the LEC pad pattern and the probe card, so one start serves all their dies and imaging types (LEC, BAM, SEG, L0-L2)
_help.when to edit: after moving the probe card or the camera: the die position shifts relative to the camera, so the first tile must be shifted the same way
_help.not used by: TakeImageWafer_ER2 (its own start and wafer centre, relative to SEG4), BrightnessCorrection / FlatfieldCalibration (from the wafer centre), the Debug* sequences
